# sh-fpv-education-career

**Purpose:** Education & Career.

**Built from:** sh-fpv-section-title + sh-fpv-info-item (+ sh-fpv-locked-text for college names) or sh-blur-overlay.

**Switches:** Plan × State.

**Rules:** one mask per section, cheapest step first.

**Taps:** Unlock → premium plans · Add Now → add own details.

Full profile view (migration, not yet core) · 3 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2877-19759) (node `2877:19759`)

## Types
